inputs.original_text: Local organizers are gathering signatures to protect southern Alberta’s watershed from coal mining. Water Not Coal, started by Corb Lund last month, is seeking signatures for a citizen initiative petition calling on the Government of Alberta to “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration…” The message cuts off there.
